Arsenal vs Burnley Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

The Premier League clash between Arsenal and Burnley will take place on May 18, 2026, at the Emirates Stadium in London. This match could have significant implications as teams vie for points in the final stretch of the season.

Fixture Details

Match Date Kickoff ET PT GMT CET AEDT Venue Competition
Arsenal vs Burnley May 18, 2026 3:00 PM 12:00 PM 7:00 PM 9:00 PM 5:00 AM (May 19) Emirates Stadium Premier League

Why This Match Matters

As the season nears its conclusion, Arsenal sits in the top four of the Premier League standings, currently battling for a Champions League spot with 68 points. Burnley, with 25 points, is in the relegation zone and desperately needs a win to have any hope of survival. Each team has a lot on the line, making this a crucial match for both sides.

Current Season Statistics

Arsenal: W: 20, D: 8, L: 5, Goals Scored: 65, Goals Scored per Game: 2.04, Goals Conceded per Game: 1.12

Burnley: W: 5, D: 10, L: 18, Goals Scored: 36, Goals Scored per Game: 1.14, Goals Conceded per Game: 2.36

Arsenal is currently on a 5-match unbeaten run, while Burnley is struggling to find form with only 1 win in their last 5 matches.

Top Performers

Arsenal: Top Scorer: Bukayo Saka (17 goals), Top Assist Provider: Martin Ødegaard (11 assists). Saka has been in excellent form, contributing significantly to Arsenal's attacking prowess.

Burnley: Top Scorer: Jay Rodriguez (8 goals), Top Assist Provider: Dwight McNeil (5 assists). Rodriguez has been pivotal in Burnley's attempts to climb out of the relegation battle.
